# purchases_flutter

**Tag**: mobile, desktop

## 简介

Flutter in-app purchases and subscriptions made easy. The plugin supports iOS, macOS and Android.

## 官网

- 主页: https://www.revenuecat.com/
- 源码仓库: https://github.com/RevenueCat/purchases-flutter
- 问题追踪: https://github.com/RevenueCat/purchases-flutter/issues
- 文档: https://docs.revenuecat.com/docs
- pub.dev: https://pub.dev/packages/purchases_flutter
